resources.string: Plays back gestures that you create inside the iMacro Touch app. This service only dispatches gestures you explicitly author and save; it does not record touches from other applications.
To play macros on the screen, iMacro Touch needs the Accessibility service. You will be taken to Android Settings where you can enable “iMacro Touch”. The app never enables this automatically.
The floating control bubble needs permission to appear over other apps. You will be taken to the system settings screen to grant it. You can revoke it at any time.
